name: trench-lines
coordinates: Board inches, origin bottom-left as data/rules/scenarios.json. Board +x is world +x (E), board +y is world +z (N). footprintIn, heightIn and pivotOffsetIn (visual bounds centre minus pivot) are the mesh's visual bounds at rotY 0. restHeightIn is the pivot height above whatever the piece rests on, measured by letting it settle; topIn is the height of a piece's top above its own support, for pieces others stand on. A piece's support height (baseIn) is worked out by the generator from the stack under it.

rotation.note: Verified live 2026-11-04: Landscape 1x2 at rotY 0 has its bounds centre 2in toward -z of the pivot; at rotY 90 it is 2in toward -x. So +rotY turns -z into -x, i.e. +z into +x: clockwise from above.

revetment.source: Placed live 2026-11-04 against the bare -x wall of the plain straight: body centre 1.35 in from the cell centre, bottom 0.20 above the trench's base, rotY 0 for a -x wall (90 for +z, 180 for +x, 270 for -z); visually confirmed to read like the built-in Double Logs. The inner wall faces of the plain, ledge, logs, corner and T pieces measure within 0.06in of each other by collider raycast, so the same inset serves them all.

large-L-ruin.note: Big L-shaped wall ruins, about 6in a side.

tall-tower.note: Towers 6-10in tall: outposts, water towers, watchtowers.

landmark.note: Statues, crosses, pillars, tanks: solid single pieces.

wreck.note: Wrecked vehicles (the Trench Lines landmark list names them).

wall-run.note: Straight runs of wall or fence that block sight lines.

sources.footprints: data/tts/palette-measured-v2.json (live TTS 2026-11-04: collider and visual bounds, rest heights, stacked rest heights); earlier values in palette-measured.json and rest-heights-measured.json
sources.openings: Measured and visually verified in the live game, top-down capture with a +z marker, 2026-11-04 (coordinator message to TC-021)
sources.verticality: data/tts/VERTICALITY.md: how the reference maps stack pieces
sources.catalog: data/tts/catalog.json supplies kind, urls, scale and colour at build time
sources.categories: TC-021c: categories by footprint and silhouette, aesthetic tags by asset name and source bag; the scatter set measured live 2026-11-04 (palette-measured-v2.json scatterRun)

pieces.name: Landscape 1x4
pieces.note: Named 1x4 in the source mods; an 8x8 (2x2 cell) block. Collider top 2.58 above its support (0.08 above the 1x1).

pieces.name: Landscape 1x4 Crater
pieces.note: Ground tile with the crater centred on the 2x2 block; counts as one difficult-terrain piece.

pieces.name: Trench Straight w/ Ledge
pieces.note: Channel along z at rotY 0, walls on the x sides. Channel floor 0.5 above the bottom; the ledge occupies x -1.6..-0.4 at 1.5 high.

decoratedWalls.note: The 1.5in fire step sits on -x at rotY 0 in the collider (collider raycast of the piece spawned locked in the live game, 2026-11-04 (data/tts/VERTICALITY.md)), and Trenches Square Off's ledge straights only face no-man's-land on both lines that way. The 2026-11-04 visual note said +x; one look settles it, and flipping this field is the whole fix.

pieces.name: Trench Straight w/ Double Logs
pieces.note: Channel along z at rotY 0. Channel floor 0.5 above the piece's bottom (barrel dropped in, live 2026-11-04).

decoratedWalls.note: Logs on one wall only (live 2026-11-04), but the collider is symmetric, so which wall is not known. Not used while the source is assumed: plain straights with log fences stand in.

pieces.name: Trench Straight
pieces.note: Bare earth on both walls (live 2026-11-04). Same collider family as the ledge and logs straights: pivot 1.5 above the bottom, channel floor 0.5, wall faces 1.13-1.37 from the centre.

pieces.name: Trench Corner
pieces.note: At rotY 0 the walls are on the +z and -x edges, openings on -z and +x. Both walls are bare earth (live 2026-11-04).

pieces.name: Trench T-Section
pieces.note: At rotY 0 the log wall is on the +x edge; openings on +z, -z and -x.

decoratedWalls.note: Logs on the through wall, +x at rotY 0 (live 2026-11-04).

pieces.name: Trench Entrance
pieces.note: A ramp piece with a wall on the -x edge. Trenches Square Off places all four at the ends of its two N-S lines, rotY 0 at the south end and 180 at the north end, which puts the trench opening on +z at rotY 0 (4/4 consistent, see VERTICALITY.md). Not visually confirmed, so still unused: runs end at a board edge or a junction.

pieces.name: Landscape Hill Ramp
pieces.note: Sits on a Landscape tile (1.28 above it, live) and climbs one tile height, 2.5in. Uphill is +x at rotY 0: all 20 Hill Ramps in Trenches Square Off climb toward their raised trench line that way (VERTICALITY.md). Not visually confirmed.

pieces.name: H4x4
pieces.note: Out of the generator (TC-021f): its top is a grass texture that does not match the Landscape tiles around it (Jonathan, live review of seed 4). Hills are stacked Landscape tiles now, top 5.00 like a plateau. Kept for its measured numbers (2.1 tall, rest 0).

pieces.name: Plank Floor
pieces.note: Duckboard laid along a Double Logs trench channel; scattered terrain (p64), ignored by spacing.

pieces.name: Ruins Corner
pieces.note: A complete corner ruin: 3.19 x 3.18 x 4.70 visually; only its collider is a 2.4in floor plate, which is what made it read as a floor.

pieces.name: Ruins Large
pieces.note: 10.9 x 11.3in: too big for a 36in board.

pieces.name: Tower
pieces.note: Visual 3.96 x 4.01, 9.4 tall (collider only 3.69 x 3.71 x 7.03).

pieces.name: Tower Small
pieces.note: Visual 4.41 x 2.65, 6.87 tall; the collider is 1.66 x 1.59, which is why it looked far too big as an objective cover.

pieces.name: Watchtower
pieces.note: 9.1 x 9.4in; its collider bottom is 4.2in above the mesh bottom, so it physics-rests with the pivot 4.28 below the surface and the legs on it.

pieces.name: Barrel
pieces.note: Group member only.

pieces.name: Supplies
pieces.note: Group member only.

pieces.name: Tire Pile
pieces.note: Group member only.

pieces.name: Barbed Wire
pieces.note: Visual 3.71 x 1.77 x 1.65 coils; the collider is a 0.01in flat plate.

pieces.name: Artillery
pieces.note: Visual 5.25 x 4.36 with the barrel; the collider is only 1.12 x 1.63.

pieces.name: Log Fence
pieces.note: Upright at rotation 0 with its length along z; topples if unlocked, so it is always spawned Locked. Body centre 1.22 to +x of the pivot (collider and visual bounds agree), pivot 1.20 above its bottom.

pieces.name: Corpse
pieces.note: Renders solid magenta on macOS (seen live on the seed-4 board, 2026-11-05): the bundle (Unity 2019.4.40f1, StandaloneWindows64) carries its own copy of Mobile/Diffuse (fallback Mobile/VertexLit) compiled for D3D11 and OpenGLCore only, with no Metal program, and TTS on Apple silicon draws with Metal; Player.log: "Shader Mobile/VertexLit shader is not supported on this GPU". The source maps spawn it the same way (MaterialIndex 0, TypeIndex 0), so the asset itself is the fault.

pieces.name: Corpse
pieces.note: Same fault as corpse-a (not on the seed-4 board, found by scanning every palette bundle): the bundle (Unity 2019.4.40f1, StandaloneWindows64) carries its own Mobile/Diffuse compiled for D3D11 and OpenGLCore only, with no Metal program, so it renders magenta in TTS on macOS.

pieces.name: Jeep
pieces.note: A wrecked vehicle: the Trench Lines landmark list names wrecked vehicles.

groups.note: Three wire segments end to end: how Trenches Square Off lays its 32 Difficult + Dangerous models, in rows.
